tool_input.description: Run scratch probe to compute expected DateUtils behavior

result:
The deprecation note is from `new DateUtils()`, which exercises the deprecated public constructor intentionally — expected and harmless.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/DateUtilsAgentTest.java` with 46 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering `DateUtils`: add/set/ceiling/round/truncate operations, fragment calculations, same-day/instant/local-time comparisons, the range iterator (including `NoSuchElementException` and `remove()` behavior), lenient vs. strict parsing, `java.time` conversions, truncated comparisons, constants, and boundary/error cases (null args, out-of-range values, unsupported fields, oversized years, invalid range styles, type-mismatched `Object` overloads). All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
